method: Candidates: USDA FNDDS dish names matched against (a) a documented dish-name keyword list and (b) Wikidata dish items (CC0) linked to a cuisine (P2012) or country of origin (P495), keeping only main English labels that map to exactly one of the app's eight cuisines and contain a word rare in USDA SR Legacy names (scripts/cuisine_candidates.py). Each (food, cuisine) pair was then checked by two independent reviewers; only pairs both kept are listed. Cuisine tags only rank food ideas; they never change a nutrient value.
licence: Wikidata content is CC0 1.0; USDA FoodData Central names are public domain.
